answer_1.quote: We generate full dialogues by alternating between generating from the red LM and the target LM... We generate conversation-starting questions as test cases, as these often begin chit‑chat dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: test case questions, chatbot replies, full dialogues

answer_2.quote: We measure the diversity of generated test cases using Self‑BLEU... we also measure the entropy of the n‑gram distribution... we compute the 'Zipf coefficient'... the percent of replies that are offensive is reported as an automatic metric.
